name: Asuna Shiroki
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 card with [Three Musketeers] in its text or the [TS] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.

source_effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
